expand.title: 扩展知识 Hang 悬、挂 / 绞死
lines: 4 不同词意导致的不同变化 We must all hang together, or assuredly we shall all hang separately . - Benjamin Franklin (一词两意) 每日习语 by the book 照章办事, 循规蹈矩
Hang vi. 悬、挂 ( h u ng 、h u ng) I ’m hanging this picture on the wall. A painter who had been working on the tower hung a pot of paint on one of the hands and slowed it down!
vt. 绞死，吊死，上吊( hang ed 、 hang ed ) The hero was hanged . As he has murdered three men, he ought to be hanged . I wonder why she hanged herself.
I hung my coat in the hall.
Murderers will not be hanged in future.
